full_list.title_en: Scalene Yang-Baxter triples realize all nearest-neighbour Hamiltonians with global additive symmetries
full_list.title_zh: Scalene Yang-Baxter 三元组实现了具有全局加性对称性的所有最近邻哈密顿量
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.13782v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We establish that bond Hamiltonian densities, up to local difference terms whose sum vanishes under periodic boundary conditions, lying in the commutant of bond operators, wⱼ± wⱼ₊₁, is a necessary and sufficient condition for a one-dimensional nearest-neighbour Hamiltonian to conserve a uniform or staggered sum of the one-site operators wⱼ. Starting from these local commutants, we show that every such Hamiltonian and its conserved charge can be obtained from monodromy matrices constructed using regular and non-regular members of scalene Yang-Baxter triples. The results hold on periodic chains of length L≥3, with even length required in the staggered case. The results do not require translation invariance, and hence the interaction on each bond can be chosen independently from the full corresponding commutant. Our representation-independent construction applies in arbitrary finite local dimension and exhausts the Hamiltonians with either prescribed additive symmetry, without requiring ordinary Yang-Baxter integrability. We illustrate the construction with spin-tfrac12 and spin-1 systems and discuss its relation to the double-commutant theorem. Classifying the one-site generators w and their associated bond commutants provides a route to classifying such Hamiltonians with additive conserved charges.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们建立了键哈密顿密度，直到其和在周期性边界条件下消失的局部差分项，位于键算子的交换子 wⱼ± wⱼ₊₁ 中，是一维最近邻哈密顿量守恒单点算子 wⱼ 的均匀或交错和的充分必要条件。从这些局部交换子开始，我们证明了每个这样的哈密顿量及其守恒电荷都可以从使用不等边斜角杨-巴克斯特三元组的规则和非常规成员构造的单向矩阵中获得。结果适用于长度 L≥3 的周期链，并且交错情况下要求长度均匀。结果不需要平移不变性，因此每个键上的相互作用可以独立于完全相应的交换子进行选择。

full_list.title_en: Finite-momentum superconductivity with singlet-triplet mixing in an altermagnetic metal: A pairing instability analysis
full_list.title_zh: 互磁金属中单重态-三重态混合的有限动量超导：配对不稳定性分析
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2603.12897v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We analyze the pairing instability of an altermagnetic metal on a square lattice driven by an attractive nearest-neighbor interaction. This interaction enables multiple pairing channels, including even-parity extended s-wave and d-wave states, as well as two odd-parity p-wave channels. We verify that altermagnetic spin-splitting in the single-particle dispersion gives rise to finite-momentum pairing between electrons with unlike spins, in agreement with earlier predictions. Quite unexpectedly, this pairing typically emerges across multiple channels with mixed parity. Consequently, the resulting finite-momentum Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) superconducting phase is expected to exhibit a multi-component order parameter featuring singlet-triplet mixing. We examine several forms of altermagnetism, specifically dₓy-wave and dₓ²-y²-wave altermagnetic couplings, and present the corresponding phase diagrams. Additionally, we study triplet pairing between electrons with identical spins and find that it always occurs at zero center-of-mass momentum. Although it is unfavorable in the regime of weak altermagnetic coupling and low electron filling, it can dominate the phase diagram when the altermagnetic coupling is sufficiently strong. The influence of on-site attractive interactions on mixed-parity pairing is also explored.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们分析了由吸引的最近邻相互作用驱动的方晶格上交磁金属的配对不稳定性。这种相互作用实现了多个配对通道，包括偶奇偶校验扩展 s 波和 d 波状态，以及两个奇奇偶校验 p 波通道。我们验证了单粒子分散体中的交变磁自旋分裂会在具有不同自旋的电子之间产生有限动量配对，这与早期的预测一致。出乎意料的是，这种配对通常出现在具有混合奇偶校验的多个渠道中。

full_list.title_en: Frustration induced dimensional reduction and coexistence of long and short-range magnetic order in NdCl₃
full_list.title_zh: NdCl₃中挫败引起的降维以及长程和短程磁序的共存
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2607.17995v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The phenomenon of frustration greatly enriches the accessible physics of quantum magnets. With this in mind we study the magnetism of NC using a combination of bulk properties measurements and neutron scattering techniques. The low-temperature heat capacity reveals two magnetic transitions at TN₁ = 270 mK and TN₂ = 180 mK. However, much of the magnetic entropy is released above TN₁, manifesting as a broad peak centered at T* approx 450 mK. A similar broad peak is observed in the magnetic susceptibility, which possesses a clear anisotropy; this data can be well fit using a 1-dimensional XXZ model, yielding an antiferromagnetic nearest-neighbor exchange JNN = -0.962(2) K and exchange anisotropy close to the Ising limit. Single crystal elastic neutron scattering reveals highly anisotropic magnetic diffuse scattering above TN₁, confirming that quasi-one-dimensional, short-range, antiferromagnetic order is the origin of the broad peak in the heat capacity and magnetic susceptibility. Magnetic Bragg peaks characterized by a veck = (0 0 frac12) propagation vector emerge below TN₁. Interestingly, the magnetic diffuse scattering persists for TN₂ < T < TN₁, indicating a regime of coexisting short and long-range order. The magnetic Bragg peaks exhibit an additional increase in intensity below TN₂ with no change in veck. Concomitantly, the diffuse scattering disappears indicating the attainment of full long-range order. While the precise nature of the ordered magnetic ground state remains unresolved, the observed magnetic scattering indicates predominate c-axis moments with a small ab-plane component. We propose that the quasi-one-dimensional behavior and the coexistence of short and long-range order are driven by frustration of exchange interactions with significant anisotropy.
full_list.abstract_zh: 挫败现象极大地丰富了量子磁体的可理解物理学。考虑到这一点，我们结合体特性测量和中子散射技术来研究 NC 的磁性。低温热容揭示了 TN₁ = 270 mK 和 TN2 = 180 mK 处的两个磁转变。然而，大部分磁熵在 TN₁ 以上释放，表现为以 T* 约 450 mK 为中心的宽峰。磁化率也观察到类似的宽峰，具有明显的各向异性；该数据可以使用一维 XXZ 模型很好地拟合，产生反铁磁最近邻交换 JNN = -0.962(2) K 和接近伊辛极限的交换各向异性。

full_list.title_en: Unifying spherical convolutions through lifting
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Unifying spherical convolutions through lifting
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.13892v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop a unified description of convolution on the sphere by lifting to the rotation group. A number of definitions of spherical convolution have been proposed, differing in whether the kernel is axisymmetric or directional, whether the output is on the sphere or the rotation group, whether the signals carry spin, and in their computational cost. No unified treatment exists. Regarding the sphere as the homogeneous space S² cong SO(3)/SO(2), we lift a spin s field to the rotation group, convolve on SO(3), and project back to the sphere through the adjoint of the lift for a potentially different spin s'. We recover every rotation-equivariant convolution considered previously through constraints on the kernel, spin choices and inclusion or omission of the lift and projection. For maps between fields of fixed input and output spin, we prove that directional kernels, output on the sphere and equivariance cannot be achieved simultaneously. We make explicit that spin fields are sections of associated line bundles, linking the physics and bundle literatures, and express the spin rotation phase as the character of the twist of the section. We present harmonic-space algorithms for the exact and efficient computation of lifted spherical convolutions of band-limited fields by appealing to sampling theorems on the sphere and rotation group. All operators are implemented in the open-source s2conv code, and numerical experiments confirm the reductions and the equivariance of the operators to machine precision. Finally, we illustrate the operators on fields measured on the Earth and on the celestial sky.

full_list.title_en: Centrosymmetric imidazolium hydrogen squarate structure: Catalytic properties, chemical reactivity and electronic structure
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Centrosymmetric imidazolium hydrogen squarate structure: Catalytic properties, chemical reactivity and electronic structure
full_list.abstract: The catalytic performance, chemical reactivity and electronic structure of the centrosymmetric ion pair imidazolium hydrogen squarate ([C3H5N2]+[C4O4H]–) were investigated experimentally and theoretically in this paper for the first time. This comprehensive evaluation was carried out using Hammett acidity (H₀) measurements, MEP analysis, FMO theory, Fukui function and NPA analysis. DFT calculations were performed at the B3LYP/6-311 + + G(2d,2p) level of theory. The catalytic activity of [C3H5N2]+[C4O4H]– was assessed in the butyl acetate synthesis. The reaction kinetics, thermodynamic parameters, as well as the effects of reaction temperature (60–80°C) and catalyst content (5–12 wt%) were methodically inspected. Intrinsic reaction coordinate (IRC) calculations were made and a catalytic cycle for butyl acetate synthesis was proposed. The nucleophilic and electrophilic reactivity of [C3H5N2]+[C4O4H]– is associated with the cation and anion, respectively. The positively charged site within the [C3H5N2]+ was denoted the compound's Brønsted acidity (H₀ = 1.909). Moieties in the hydrogen squarate anion were found to govern the catalytic performance of the ion pair [C3H5N2]+[C4O4H]– in butyl acetate synthesis. The reaction proceeded through the formation of an activated complex, as confirmed by the IRC calculations.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《由二维柔性铁电单晶薄膜中的光压电耦合驱动的双加密紫外光通信》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: An Instability of the Quantum Markov Length
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：An Instability of the Quantum Markov Length
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.12929v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Markov length, the length scale governing the exponential decay of conditional mutual information (CMI) in a quantum many-body state, has proven useful for characterizing mixed-state phases of matter. Nevertheless, we show that a state's Markov length is not generally stable under weak local channels. The failure of stability occurs already at a pure product state. We demonstrate this explicitly in a one-dimensional fermionic chain, where a fine-tuned depth-two circuit of nearest-neighbor Gaussian channels maps the vacuum to a state whose CMI decays emphalgebraically and whose Markov length is therefore infinite, even when the channels are taken arbitrarily close to the identity. The algebraic decay is rooted in the nonanalyticity of the von Neumann entropy at rank-deficient density operators. We exhibit an analogous instability on an ordinary qubit chain. More generally, we show that the Markov length is unstable in any translation-invariant state with even a single rank-deficient reduced density operator. These results pose a challenge to recent definitions of mixed-state phase equivalence based on the Markov length.

full_list.title_en: Anomaly induced transport in holographic superconductors
full_list.title_zh: 全息超导体中的异常诱导输运
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.13727v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate the anomaly-induced transport properties of a holographic superconductor exhibiting spontaneous symmetry breaking. The holographic model incorporates vector and axial gauge fields, an additional non-anomalous U(1) symmetry, and a charged scalar field that drives the phase transition. Working in the probe limit, we numerically construct the superconducting background under two alternative scalar field quantizations, corresponding to operators with scaling dimensions Δ=1 and Δ=3 (denoted as the O₁ and O₂ theories, respectively). Using Kubo formulae, we compute the chiral magnetic conductivities and examine their response to the scalar condensate. Our findings demonstrate that spontaneous symmetry breaking allows anomaly-induced transport to extend beyond anomalous currents, significantly impacting the non-anomalous sector as well. Remarkably, this effect appears in both theories, indicating that the influence on the non-anomalous sector is independent of the chosen quantization. The comparison of our numerical results with the analytical limits for Oᵢ → 0 and Oᵢ → infty (i=1,2) reveals consistent behavior across both theories.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了表现出自发对称破缺的全息超导体的异常诱导输运特性。全息模型包含矢量和轴向规范场、附加的非反常 U(1) 对称性以及驱动相变的带电标量场。在探测极限下，我们在两个替代标量场量子化下以数值方式构造超导背景，对应于缩放维数 Δ=1 和 Δ=3 的算子（分别表示为 O₁ 和 O2 理论）。使用 Kubo 公式，我们计算手性磁导率并检查它们对标量凝聚的响应。我们的研究结果表明，自发对称性破缺使得异常引起的传输能够扩展到异常电流之外，从而对非异常区域产生重大影响。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了表现出自发对称破缺的全息超导体的异常诱导输运特性。全息模型包含矢量和轴向规范场、附加的非反常 U(1) 对称性以及驱动相变的带电标量场。在探测极限下，我们在两个替代标量场量子化下以数值方式构造超导背景，对应于缩放维数 Δ=1 和 Δ=3 的算子（分别表示为 O₁ 和 O2 理论）。使用 Kubo 公式，我们计算手性磁导率并检查它们对标量凝聚的响应。我们的研究结果表明，自发对称性破缺使得异常引起的传输能够扩展到异常电流之外，从而对非异常区域产生重大影响。值得注意的是，这种效应出现在两种理论中，表明对非异常部分的影响与所选的量化无关。我们的数值结果与 Oᵢ → 0 和 Oᵢ → infty (i=1,2) 的分析极限的比较揭示了两种理论的一致行为。

full_list.title_en: Correlated Pair Creation with Positive- and Negative-Frequency Oscillators in a Trapped-Ion Quantum Simulator
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Correlated Pair Creation with Positive- and Negative-Frequency Oscillators in a Trapped-Ion Quantum Simulator
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.12579v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Spin-dependent forces enable independent control over the effective frequencies of bosonic motional modes and their coupling strengths to spins in trapped-ion spin-boson quantum simulators. We show that the relative signs of these effective frequencies provide an important programmable resource for engineering distinct multimode dynamics. Focusing on a two-mode quantum Rabi model, changing the frequencies of the two modes from the same sign to opposite signs reorganizes the resonance structure of the spin-mediated bosonic interaction, converting the dominant resonant process from excitation exchange to correlated pair creation. In the dispersive regime, the resulting effective interaction realizes a two-mode parametric amplifier with stable oscillatory, critical, and exponentially amplifying regimes separated by a spin-dependent instability threshold. Across these regimes, the dynamics generate collective-quadrature squeezing and bipartite motional entanglement. Preparing the spin in a coherent superposition further allows different spin components to experience distinct stability regimes, generating tripartite spin-boson entanglement, while spin postselection can coherently combine the conditional bosonic branches to generate non-Gaussian entangled bosonic states. Finally, we outline an implementation using parameters within reach of current trapped-ion platforms.

full_list.title_en: Demonstration of on-chip all-optical switching of magnetization in integrated photonics
full_list.title_zh: 集成光子学中磁化强度的片上全光开关演示
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2511.02440v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Ultrafast all-optical magnetization switching (AOS) holds great promise for nextgeneration spintronic memory and hybrid spintronic-photonic systems. However, most implementations to date rely on bulky free-space optical setups, limiting scalability and practical integration. As a critical step toward integrated applications, we demonstrate single-pulse AOS within a silicon nitride (Si3N4) photonic integrated circuit. Using trains of femtosecond laser pulses guided through on-chip waveguides, we achieve deterministic toggle switching in a sub-micron out-of-plane Co/Gd Hall cross patterned directly atop the photonic waveguide. Electrical readout via the anomalous Hall effect reveals a switching contrast of up to 90% for 500 nm-wide devices. In larger Hall crosses, the contrast decreases and switching becomes stochastic, consistent with spatially non-uniform optical absorption as confirmed by finite-element simulations. This behavior is hypothetically attributed to domain wall relaxation and thermally assisted (de)pinning processes within partially switched regions. Our results highlight the critical role of device scaling in achieving robust on-chip AOS and establish a foundation for ultrafast, energy-efficient, and fully integrated spintronic-photonic platforms.
full_list.abstract_zh: 超快全光磁化开关（AOS）为下一代自旋电子存储器和混合自旋电子光子系统带来了巨大的希望。然而，迄今为止，大多数实现都依赖于笨重的自由空间光学设置，限制了可扩展性和实际集成。作为集成应用的关键一步，我们在氮化硅 (Si3N4) 光子集成电路中演示了单脉冲 AOS。使用通过片上波导引导的飞秒激光脉冲序列，我们在直接位于光子波导顶部的亚微米面外 Co/Gd 霍尔交叉图案中实现了确定性切换。通过反常霍尔效应的电读数显示 500 nm 宽器件的开关对比度高达 90%。

full_list.title_en: Domain-wall circulation gating and pinning via compositional engineering of cylindrical nanowires
full_list.title_zh: 通过圆柱形纳米线的组合工程实现畴壁循环选通和钉扎
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2405.00652v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Spintronic devices based on cylindrical magnetic nanowires have been proposed as a route toward three-dimensional information storage and processing by harnessing the controlled motion of domain walls (DWs). In this geometry, the Bloch-point wall (BPW) is the characteristic DW type. It features a curling of magnetization around a Bloch Point singularity, a topology that has been predicted to enable propagation at high speed without undergoing a Walker breakdown. We demonstrate that compositional modulations of larger magnetization, which host spontaneous curling states while the rest of the wire remains axial, fulfil a dual role: they act as deterministic pinning sites and as active gates for BPW circulation. Combining magnetic transmission X-ray microscopy and micromagnetic simulations, we reveal that DW-modulation interactions are the result of a superposition of long-range magnetostatic repulsion and short-range, circulation-dependent exchange contributions: parallel circulation produces an attractive well, while opposite circulation generates a repulsive barrier. This results in DW pinning at or near a compositional modulation. A DW's internal circulation can be inverted upon traversing a modulation, enabling on-demand switching of its circulation state. This dual mechanism demonstrates that both DW position and circulation can be tuned in a controlled manner, with potential implications for multistate spintronic devices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 基于圆柱形磁性纳米线的自旋电子器件已被提出作为通过利用磁畴壁（DW）的受控运动来实现三维信息存储和处理的途径。在此几何结构中，布洛赫点墙 (BPW) 是典型的 DW 类型。它具有围绕布洛赫点奇点的磁化卷曲，这种拓扑结构预计可以实现高速传播而不会发生沃克击穿。我们证明，较大磁化强度的成分调制（其具有自发卷曲状态，而线的其余部分保持轴向）具有双重作用：它们充当确定性钉扎位点和 BPW 循环的主动门。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 基于圆柱形磁性纳米线的自旋电子器件已被提出作为通过利用磁畴壁（DW）的受控运动来实现三维信息存储和处理的途径。在此几何结构中，布洛赫点墙 (BPW) 是典型的 DW 类型。它具有围绕布洛赫点奇点的磁化卷曲，这种拓扑结构预计可以实现高速传播而不会发生沃克击穿。我们证明，较大磁化强度的成分调制（其具有自发卷曲状态，而线的其余部分保持轴向）具有双重作用：它们充当确定性钉扎位点和 BPW 循环的主动门。结合磁透射 X 射线显微镜和微磁模拟，我们揭示了 DW 调制相互作用是长程静磁斥力和短程、依赖环流的交换贡献叠加的结果：平行环流产生吸引势垒，而反向环流产生排斥势垒。这导致 DW 固定在或接近合成调制。 DW 的内部循环可以在遍历调制时反转，从而实现其循环状态的按需切换。这种双重机制表明，DW 位置和循环都可以以受控方式进行调整，这对多态自旋电子器件具有潜在影响。

full_list.title_en: Electron binding by charge disorder surrounding gapped bilayer graphene
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Electron binding by charge disorder surrounding gapped bilayer graphene
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.12714v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bilayer graphene (BLG) is a unique electronic material offering electrostatic tunability of its band gap. Here, we study how charge disorder in the dielectric environment modifies band-edge states by binding electrons and holes to Coulomb centres, taking into account the in- and out-of-plane dielectric response of Bernal bilayers. We apply this framework to (a) hBN-encapsulated medium-size-gap BLG used for gate-defined quantum dots, and (b) BLG under double n/p ionic gating. In hBN/BLG/hBN, we find that single remote charges produce only weakly bound states, with binding energies generally small compared with the BLG gap. Under ionic gating, we find that the bound states are too large to be trapped by individual ions -- localisation arises from fluctuations in the ion density, whose magnitude is limited by Coulomb charging energy at the freezing temperature T_f of the ionic configuration. Thus, in both regimes, charge disorder does not produce deep midgap states, with the bound states remaining closer to the conduction and valence band edges.

full_list.title_en: Electron- and hole-doped superconductivity in two-dimensional electride ZrX₂ (X = Cl, Br, I)
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Electron- and hole-doped superconductivity in two-dimensional electride ZrX₂ (X = Cl, Br, I)
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.13124v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) superconducting systems have recently emerged as a frontier in condensed matter physics, driven by their unique physical properties and potential applications. Using first-principles calculations, we show that monolayer ZrX₂ (X = Cl, Br, I), which is a family of 2D semiconducting electrides, hosts phonon-mediated superconductivity under both electron and hole dopings. Electron doping in ZrX₂ can achieve high superconducting transition temperatures at very low concentrations, with ZrBr₂ reaching T_c = 30.0 K at 0.01 e/f.u., followed by ZrCl₂ (22.5 K at 0.05 e/f.u.) and ZrI₂ (18.1 K at 0.01 e/f.u.), for which the high T_c originates from the flat conduction band minimum, with Van Hove singularities nearby enhancing the density of states. In contrast, hole doping requires higher concentrations (0.2--0.25 h/f.u.) to activate superconductivity, yielding T_c sim 2 K, and approaches a magnetic instability at elevated doping levels. By comparing with InSe and LaBr₂, we identify the spatial location and orbital character of excess electrons as key factors determining the strength of hole-doped superconductivity and the nature of competing orders. These findings establish monolayer ZrX₂ as a platform for bipolar superconductivity in a 2D electride and provide insights into flat-band engineering for high-T_c superconductors.

full_list.title_en: Error correction and quantum information spreading on sparse random graphs
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Error correction and quantum information spreading on sparse random graphs
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.12597v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum error-correcting codes on graph geometries beyond regular euclidean lattices have emerged as a promising route toward robust quantum information processing. A major challenge in quantum error correction is the trade-off between favorable properties of codes constructed in high dimensionality and the need for locality in practical implementations on near-term hardware. Sparse intermediate geometries may combine the advantages of both, but how their structure governs quantum information dynamics and code performance remains unclear. Here we show that the spectral dimension dₛ, defined from the low-energy spectrum of the graph Laplacian, is the universal parameter connecting these properties. Using Floquet random Clifford circuits on two distinct sparse graph architectures with tunable spectral dimension, we find that dₛ governs both quantum information spreading and the scaling of the resulting quantum error-correcting code distance. We identify a geometry-induced entanglement phase transition from localized area-law to ergodic volume-law, whose universality is determined by dₛ and exhibits long-range percolation criticality. In the ergodic phase, the circuit acts as a CSS code encoder whose code distance is set by the competition between two logical sectors --- the cost of severing the graph and the length of its shortest winding cycle --- which connectivity pushes in opposite directions. The spectral dimension organizes this trade-off, highlighting a maximum at intermediate dₛ retaining sparse connectivity and physical realizability.

full_list.title_en: Evolution and breakdown of chiral anomaly in Weyl semiconductor tellurium
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Evolution and breakdown of chiral anomaly in Weyl semiconductor tellurium
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.13084v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chiral anomaly in topological materials manifests as negative longitudinal magnetoresistance, yet the tunability and evolution of this effect remain elusive. Here we show that doped tellurium serves as a versatile platform to realize a giant negative longitudinal magnetoresistance that is highly tunable via the Fermi level and magnetic field. By moving the Fermi level towards the Weyl point, we observe a pronounced enhancement of negative magnetoresistance, which arises from chiral anomaly and robustly persists up to ambient temperature. Beyond the quantum limit, the system exhibits positive linear magnetoconductance, serving as a compelling transport signature of the chiral anomaly in the lowest Landau level. Notably, in the extreme quantum limit at cryogenic temperatures, the magnetoresistance undergoes a dramatic reversal from negative to positive. This reversal points to a potential field-induced phase transition into a collective electronic state driven by enhanced electron-electron interactions. Our findings provide valuable insights into the unconventional chiral transport and emergent correlated quantum states under extreme magnetic fields.

full_list.title_en: Giant geometric nonlinear transport in inhomogeneously strained Bi₂Se₃ single crystalline slabs
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Giant geometric nonlinear transport in inhomogeneously strained Bi₂Se₃ single crystalline slabs
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.13542v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrical transport in non-centrosymmetric materials exhibits a nonlinear conductivity tensor component that generates second-harmonic voltages in response to applied electric fields. Harnessing this effect is essential for developing zero-threshold electromagnetic energy harvesters and broadband frequency upconverters, both of which require maximizing the nonlinear responsivity. Here, we demonstrate that inhomogeneously strained macroscopic slabs of the topological insulator Bi₂Se₃ achieve a record-high nonlinear responsivity of 10⁴,μm/V: a six orders of magnitude boost compared to its thin-film counterparts. We attribute this giant enhancement to a classical geometric nonlinear transport effect, which is driven by complex strain gradients within the bulk material. Notably, a similar geometric mechanism known as geometric nonlinear Hall was previously observed only in microscale-patterned structures. Our findings establish macroscopic strain engineering as a powerful route to enhance nonlinear transport, with immediate relevance to a broad class of layered systems, including transition metal dichalcogenides and moiré heterostructures.

full_list.title_en: Graphene double quantum dot as a solid-state two-level system in the THz range
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Graphene double quantum dot as a solid-state two-level system in the THz range
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.13196v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Matter-based two-level quantum systems are fundamental building blocks of quantum technologies, underpinning applications in quantum computing, simulation, communication, and sensing. Today, most of these two-level quantum systems, including Rydberg atoms, trapped ions, superconducting circuits, molecules, and quantum dots, involve transition frequencies in microwave or optical domains. However, extending their transition frequency to the THz spectral range could provide numerous benefits, leveraging the unique properties of THz radiation. Here, we show that an hBN-encapsulated graphene double quantum dot realizes a two-level system with a transition frequency in the THz spectral range. Using low-temperature transport spectroscopy in the dark combined with modeling based on nonequilibrium Green's function formalism, we demonstrate the formation of an artificial molecule, featuring bonding and antibonding states separated by an energy of up to 0.6 meV, corresponding to a resonance frequency of 0.145 THz. This approach provides direct access to important parameters of open double quantum dot systems, including tunneling rates, offering a practical alternative to conventional techniques such as photon-assisted tunneling, which are challenging to implement at THz frequencies. The realized 2D-material-based THz two-level system, compatible with direct on-chip integration, could serve as a key building block for future THz quantum technologies. Furthermore, by involving a single-electron transition, coupling these devices to a THz resonator could enable the exploration of ultra-strong light-matter interactions at the fundamental limit of a single transition coupled to a single cavity, beyond the reach of existing THz quantum systems based on collective transitions.

full_list.title_en: High-Throughput Discovery of Chiral Carbon-Boron Semimetals with Weyl Topology and Phonon-Mediated Superconductivity
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：High-Throughput Discovery of Chiral Carbon-Boron Semimetals with Weyl Topology and Phonon-Mediated Superconductivity
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.12965v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chiral crystals provide a natural platform for unconventional topological fermions, while light-element carbon--boron frameworks are promising for phonon-mediated superconductivity owing to strong covalent bonding and high phonon frequencies. Here, we combine Wyckoff-position-based structure generation with high-throughput first-principles calculations to search for C--B crystals in selected hexagonal chiral space groups. Starting from 972 generated CₘBₙ structures (m,n=1--4), successive filters based on energetic stability, dynamical stability, electronic metallicity, topological band features, and thermal stability identify six stable candidates: (C₃B₂)₈, (CB₂)₃, (CB₄)₆, (C₃B₂)₆, (C₂B₃)₆, and (CB₂)₆. These materials host diverse topological semimetal states near the Fermi level, including charge-one, charge-two, and charge-three Weyl points, nodal rings, and nodal-surface states. Notably, (C₃B₂)₈ exhibits screw-symmetry-protected charge-three Weyl points and strong electron--phonon coupling, yielding a McMillan transition temperature of 31.1,K for the Coulomb pseudopotential parameter μ^* = 0.10. In addition, (CB₂)₃ hosts multiple charge-one Weyl points and pronounced anisotropic multiband superconductivity revealed by fully anisotropic Eliashberg calculations. These results extend the materials scope of topological semimetals with phonon-mediated superconductivity to chemically designed chiral light-element structures.

full_list.title_en: Locality-Preparation Time Tradeoffs in Dissipative Quantum Systems

full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.13784v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Dissipative state preparation engineers quantum many-body states as steady states of an open-system dynamics. The spatial range of the required dissipation sets both the feasibility of analog implementations and the connectivity and control complexity of digital ones. Yet how this locality quantitatively constrains preparation times remains largely unknown. Here, we establish an exact locality-preparation time relation for quadratic fermionic systems and develop a construction that optimizes the locality of the dissipative dynamics while preserving the target state. Applied to the Kitaev chain, our framework reveals sharply different locality-preparation time tradeoffs in critical and gapped regimes. At criticality, suppressing the algebraic tails of the jump operators necessarily forces the preparation time to grow algebraically with system size. By contrast, both trivial and topological gapped phases admit exponentially localized dissipation with a finite preparation time in the thermodynamic limit. Our results identify when fast dissipative preparation is compatible with local control and when criticality imposes an unavoidable dynamical cost.

full_list.title_en: Nonlocal Josephson coupling and current redistribution in a large-area graphene multiterminal Josephson junction
full_list.title_zh: 大面积石墨烯多端子约瑟夫森结中的非局部约瑟夫森耦合和电流再分布
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.12753v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multiterminal Josephson junctions (MTJJs) extend conventional two-terminal Josephson physics to devices defined by multiple superconducting phases, where rich phenomena have been predicted. However, in conventional MTJJs, superconducting transport is often dominated by local coupling between neighboring leads, obscuring physics that goes beyond simple connectivity. Here, we realize a multiterminal Josephson network in a graphene Hall bar geometry with micron-scale dimensions, enabling substantial nonlocal coupling between distant terminals. Our key observation is a pronounced negative differential longitudinal resistance (NDLR) in the four-probe response near switching currents, while no such feature appears in two-terminal measurements. We reproduce the NDLR response with a network containing the interplay between two distinct forms of nonlocality: nonlocal Josephson coupling, which determines the switching sequence of the superconducting network, and nonlocal normal-state conductance, which redistributes current after different regions switch. Our results highlight the potential of the emergent NDLR for characterizing superconductor--semiconductor hybrid systems and for nonlinear circuits. Further, this Josephson Hall bar geometry provides a platform for exploring the interplay between mesoscopic superconductivity and many-body ground states in graphene-based heterostructures.

full_list.title_en: Parity-Anomalous Hall Response of Chiral Lifshitz Fermions
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Parity-Anomalous Hall Response of Chiral Lifshitz Fermions
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.13017v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The parity anomaly of a single massless Dirac fermion is manifested as a half-quantized Hall response once the required parity-breaking regularization is supplied. We study the corresponding response for two-dimensional chiral Lifshitz fermions. For a node with low-energy coupling (qx +iqy)^N, the Fermi-loop winding number W = N gives an anomalous Hall response σxy^anom = (W/2)e²/h. We examine this mechanism in chiral multilayer Haldane models tuned to a valley-selective critical line, where a single gapless chiral Lifshitz fermion remains at the K valley. For the AB, ABC, and ABCA stacks, the projected pseudospin textures give W = 2, 3, 4, while Kubo calculations yield σxy = (1, 3/2, 2)e²/h; integrated equilibrium boundary currents reproduce the same W/2 sequence. Six-terminal simulations with dephasing further show that the Hall conductivity is quantized at W/2 while the longitudinal conductivity remains finite. These results identify gapless chiral Lifshitz fermions as a higher-order, winding-controlled generalization of the parity-anomalous Hall response, distinct from a quantum anomalous Hall insulating state even when W/2 is an integer.

full_list.title_en: Quadratic XY-anisotropy correction to the spontaneous staggered magnetization of the gapped XYZ spin-1/2 chain
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Quadratic XY-anisotropy correction to the spontaneous staggered magnetization of the gapped XYZ spin-1/2 chain
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.12798v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The staggered order parameter of the gapped XYZ spin-1/2 chain follows from the eight-vertex solution, but in elliptic variables that fix the Hamiltonian couplings only implicitly. We derive a closed form for the coefficient governing the leading quadratic response of the spontaneous staggered magnetization to the XY anisotropy at fixed longitudinal anisotropy in the gapped antiferromagnetic regime. Starting from the Baxter--Kelland--Jimbo--Miwa--Nakayashiki polarization formula, we show that at fixed longitudinal anisotropy both the modular nome and the crossing-parameter variable of the formula move with the XY anisotropy, and that the motion of the crossing-parameter variable reverses the sign of the expansion at fixed elliptic variables. The coefficient is a rational term plus a Lambert series. It is strictly negative and bounded above by a rational function of the longitudinal anisotropy, to which it is asymptotic in the Ising limit. At the isotropic point it diverges as the inverse five-halves power of the distance to that point, and since the Lambert sum has an asymptotic expansion with exponentially small remainder, the subleading terms of the divergence also follow in closed form. When the XY anisotropy vanishes as the five-fourths power of the distance to the isotropic point, the ratio of the perturbed to the unperturbed order parameter tends to a Gaussian in the scaling variable, and the quadratic truncation is controlled when that variable is small. A fourth-order perturbative calculation in the spin chain, with no input from the eight-vertex solution, reproduces the leading strong-coupling behaviour, and infinite-DMRG calculations at four anisotropies in the gapped regime are consistent with the closed form.

full_list.title_en: Quantum limit to transparency
full_list.title_zh: 透明度的量子极限
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.12560v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We argue that no material can be made completely transparent to light as long as it has a nontrivial index of refraction. The quantum decay of photons into phonons is an ineliminable source of attenuation. This survives even once all other excitations have been gapped away, impurities have been removed, and the temperature has been set to zero. Restricting for simplicity to the case of a superfluid, we determine via effective field theory methods the corresponding low-frequency contribution to the imaginary part of the index of refraction. This scales as ω⁴ and induces a nonanalyticity of the real part for ω → 0. We also extend our result to large coherent electromagnetic fields, such as those of a laser, showing that the effect can receive strong nonlinear enhancements. Our result is a genuine quantum lower bound to the transparency of a medium.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们认为，只要具有不平凡的折射率，就不可能使任何材料对光完全透明。光子到声子的量子衰变是不可消除的衰减源。即使所有其他激发都被消除、杂质被去除并且温度被设置为零，这种情况仍然存在。为了简单起见，仅限于超流体的情况，我们通过有效场论方法确定对折射率虚部的相应低频贡献。这个比例为 ω⁴ 并导致 ω → 0 实部的非解析性。我们还将我们的结果扩展到大的相干电磁场，例如激光场，表明该效应可以获得强烈的非线性增强。我们的结果是介质透明度的真正量子下界。

full_list.title_en: Search for free non-Abelian anyons in paired composite-fermion states
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Search for free non-Abelian anyons in paired composite-fermion states
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.12645v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The even-denominator fractional quantum Hall (FQH) states, understood as topological superconductors of composite fermions, are predicted to support elementary quasiparticles (QPs) or quasiholes (QHs) obeying non-Abelian braid statistics. Using the microscopic framework of parton theory, we investigate many experimentally observed paired composite-fermion states and find that their elementary QPs and QHs in general bind to form Abelian molecules, thus obscuring non-Abelian braid statistics. An exception is the ν=1/2 state in wide quantum wells, where our calculations show free QPs or QHs; we thus identify this state as an especially promising candidate for realizing and studying non-Abelian braid statistics. We also indicate how the study of such bound states can help reveal the topological structure of the state.

full_list.title_en: Symmetry-Enforced Topology and Van Hove Saddle Points in Hexagonal TiAs
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Symmetry-Enforced Topology and Van Hove Saddle Points in Hexagonal TiAs
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.12925v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the first successful growth of stoichiometric hexagonal TiAs single crystals (space group P6₃/mmc) using chemical vapor transport and investigate their vibrational, electronic, topological, and magnetotransport properties. Polarized Raman spectroscopy identifies all four Raman-active phonon modes (A₁g + E₁g + 2E₂g), consistent with the hexagonal crystal symmetry. First-principles calculations reveal nontrivial band topology characterized by a symmetry indicator Z₄ = 2 and a strong topological index ν₀ = 1, together with symmetry-protected fourfold band degeneracies at the nonsymmorphic Brillouin-zone boundary. The Fermi surface exhibits an orbital-dependent crossover from quasi-two-dimensional cylindrical sheets to a corrugated three-dimensional structure along k_z. A Van Hove saddle point approximately 0.5 eV below the Fermi level along Γ--K is associated with a neck-disrupting Lifshitz transition and enhanced density of states. Magnetotransport measurements reveal a pronounced twofold angular magnetoresistance, consistent with anisotropic Fermi-surface geometry and open cyclotron orbits. Hall measurements indicate uncompensated, hole-dominated transport, accounting for the absence of extreme magnetoresistance and contributing to the field-orientation-dependent Hall response. These results establish hexagonal TiAs as a platform for exploring the interplay of nonsymmorphic band topology, Van Hove singularities, and anisotropic electronic transport in transition-metal monopnictides.

full_list.title_en: The effects of non-stoichiometric lattice structure and secondary phase α-Fe2O3 on modifying the magnetic, electrical, and magneto-electric properties of Eu doped BaFe12O19 hexaferrite
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：The effects of non-stoichiometric lattice structure and secondary phase α-Fe2O3 on modifying the magnetic, electrical, and magneto-electric properties of Eu doped BaFe12O19 hexaferrite
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.13499v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Ba-atoms in BaFe12O19 were substituted by Eu-atoms to prepare the material of composition Ba1-xEuyFe12O19. The Eu atoms occupied at the sites of Fe atoms. The atomic ratio of Eu/Ba were varied from 0 to 0.33 to control the secondary phase (hematite) and M-type hexaferrite. Raman spectra provided complimentary support for a systematic increase of the hematite phase on increasing the Eu/Ba ratio. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy informed the presence of oxygen deficiency and surface defects, and charge state of Ba and Fe/Eu ions close to +2 and +3, respectively. The material showed direct optical transitions with band gap in the range of 2.25-3.09 eV. The increase of Eu/Ba ratio systematically increased the saturation magnetization from 84.44 emu g-1 to 57.68 emu g-1 at 3 K and 67.09 emu g-1 to 43.42 emu g-1 at 300 K, along with remarkable enhancement of the coercivity (914- 3656 Oe at 3 K and 1996-4862 Oe at 300 K). Electrical conductivity increased from 10-11-10-10 Sm-1 at 30 K to 10-5 -10-4 Sm-1 at 300 K. The electrical conductivity analysis reveals the Efros-Shklovsky-type variable-range hopping mechanism at the low-temperature region, whereas the Mott variable range hopping mechanism is applicable near to room temperature. The analysis of current-voltage characteristics provided electrode to sample interfacial barrier height of 0.27-0.74 eV. The material exhibited novel magneto-electronic properties (bi-stable electronic switching and its transformation in the temperature scale, magnetoresistance and magnetoelectric coupling) which are highly useful for spintronic devices. This work demonstrates that controlled Eu/Ba atomic ratio in the stoichiometric and non-stoichiometric lattice structure could be an effective strategy to widely tune the magnetic, optical and magneto-electronic properties in M-type Ba hexaferrite material.

full_list.title_en: The quantum geometry of the chemical bond
full_list.title_zh: 化学键的量子几何
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.12746v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electronic properties of materials depend both on band energies and quantum geometry of electronic states. We relate bonding indices to the quantum geometric tensor (QGT), showing how chemical bonding dictates the momentum-space texture of bands, bridging chemical and physical descriptions of solids. We show the QGT decomposed into the three center bond index, weighted by their oriented area. Resolving these contributions by orbital pair reveals the donor--acceptor character that distinguish ionic, covalent, hypervalent, and metavalent bonding. We identify the bonding pattern for topology in materials: noncollinear three center bonds, which are the source of Berry curvature in solids. Bond fluctuation can be directly linked to electromagnetic response by resolving their energy spectrum, opening a quantitative route towards the design of physical properties of materials from bonding motifs.
full_list.abstract_zh: 材料的电子特性既取决于能带能量，也取决于电子态的量子几何。我们将键合指数与量子几何张量（ QGT ）相关联，展示化学键合如何决定带的动量空间纹理，桥接固体的化学和物理描述。我们展示了QGT分解为三个中心债券指数，由其定向区域加权。通过轨道对解决这些贡献揭示了区分离子、共价、高价和亚价键的供体-受体特征。我们确定了材料中拓扑的键合模式：非共线三中心键，这是固体中Berry曲率的来源。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 材料的电子特性既取决于能带能量，也取决于电子态的量子几何。我们将键合指数与量子几何张量（ QGT ）相关联，展示化学键合如何决定带的动量空间纹理，桥接固体的化学和物理描述。我们展示了QGT分解为三个中心债券指数，由其定向区域加权。通过轨道对解决这些贡献揭示了区分离子、共价、高价和亚价键的供体-受体特征。我们确定了材料中拓扑的键合模式：非共线三中心键，这是固体中Berry曲率的来源。粘结波动可以通过解析其能谱直接与电磁响应联系起来，从而为从粘结基序设计材料的物理特性开辟一条定量路线。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《化学键的量子几何》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.13410v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Specific heat of graphite at high temperatures demonstrates significant deviation from the ``3R'' Dulong-Petite law. It can be explained by accumulation of defects with formation energy as low as 1.45 eV. Based on the density functional theory calculations, we propose a possible candidate of topological defects, whose energy is comparable to the growth activation energy.

full_list.title_en: Vacuum-field-mediated Landau-level reconstruction in a cavity-coupled two-dimensional electron gas
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Vacuum-field-mediated Landau-level reconstruction in a cavity-coupled two-dimensional electron gas
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.12956v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a two-dimensional electron gas in the integer quantum Hall regime coupled to a single spatially modulated cavity mode in the static off-resonant limit. Retaining both paramagnetic and diamagnetic contributions on equal footing, we derive a gauge complete single-particle Hamiltonian in which virtual photon exchange generates a periodic kinetic renormalization and a diamagnetic scalar potential. Both terms transfer momentum by 2k₀ and displace guiding centers by Δ X=2k₀ell_B², forming a finite-k₀ momentum ladder. Diagonalizing the strip Hamiltonian, we find that the ladder reconstructs the Landau-level band structure and redistributes, rather than multiplies, the associated chiral edge states. Occupied-subspace Chern numbers remain C_ν=ν for ν=1,2,3 throughout 0leλcₐᵥle 0.5, while the bulk gaps decrease without closing. Strip Kubo responses show cavity-induced displacements of the Hall-step energies; at finite width the plateau heights are noninteger and approach the integers as Lₓ increases. The ladder is spectrally resolved at k₀ell_B=0.5 and collapses at k₀ell_B=0.1. These results isolate a spatially local, finite-k₀ momentum ladder as a clean-system mechanism by which a structured vacuum field reconstructs quantum Hall spectra and strip transport without changing the integer topology, complementary to cavity-mediated all-to-all hopping.

full_list.title_en: X-ray absorption spectroscopic studies of oxygen-deficient double perovskite oxide NdBaCo₂O₅₊δ (δ sim 0.65)
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：X-ray absorption spectroscopic studies of oxygen-deficient double perovskite oxide NdBaCo₂O₅₊δ (δ sim 0.65)
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.13155v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The degree of oxygen vacancy in A-site-doped layered double perovskite oxides can lead to anion vacancy ordering, which subsequently results in distinct superstructures. We have studied oxygen deficient double perovskite oxide, NdBaCo2O₅₊δ (δ sim 0.65), utilising X-ray absorption near edge structure (XANES) spectroscopy complemented by multiple scattering and first-principles calculations based on density functional theory (DFT+U). The present results establish a direct correlation between oxygen-vacancy distribution, magnetic inhomogeneity, and charge transport in layered cobaltates. Our investigations on the Co K, Ba, and Nd LIII edges suggest that the near-edge spectra, based on the number and shape of the spectral features, indicate the value of δ for the compound under study lies closer to 0.75. The analysis of the Ba LIII edge spectrum confirms the +2 oxidation state for Ba ions. The Co K-edge near-edge spectra suggest the possibility of oxygen vacancies arising at the basal sites in addition to the apical sites. This is counterintuitive to the common understanding that oxygen vacancies usually occur at the apical sites, i.e., in the lanthanide (Nd) layer in these compounds. Such a distribution of oxygen vacancies naturally explains the Griffith phase and the conduction mechanism of variable range hopping observed in the compound. The vacancy distribution, when at the optimum level, can also bring about easier oxygen ion mobility and a more sensitive and faster oxygen sensor. We believe that our results will help in tailoring oxygen-ion mobility and enhancing oxygen-sensing performance.

full_list.title_en: Anomalous Edge Contrast in Magnetic Force Imaging of 2D Topological Insulators
full_list.title_zh: 二维拓扑绝缘体磁力成像中的反常边缘对比度
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2602.18281v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetic force imaging (MFM) of 2D topological insulators, such as crystalline plates of Bi2Te3 and Bi2Se3, reveals anomalously large contrast around the plate edges even under ambient imaging conditions. And while there are several known contrast mechanisms in MFM, these cannot easily explain the magnitude of contrast observe for such systems. In this work we use multi-parameter magnetic force phase imaging together with a simple analytical model to suggest that the observed magnetic edge-features can be associated with two sources: a pseudo-Faraday effect in the conductive edge channels of the topological system and magnetic scattering in those channels caused by the proximal, localized field of the tip. These results suggest novel MFM contrast mechanisms unique to topological systems and point to the utility of multi-parameter MFM techniques in studies of topological-material-based circuit elements.
full_list.abstract_zh: 二维拓扑绝缘体（例如 Bi2Te3 和 Bi2Se3 晶体板）的磁力成像 (MFM) 即使在环境成像条件下也能显示板边缘周围异常大的对比度。虽然 MFM 中有几种已知的对比机制，但这些机制无法轻松解释此类系统的对比观察量。在这项工作中，我们使用多参数磁力相位成像和一个简单的分析模型来表明观察到的磁边缘特征可以与两个来源相关：拓扑系统的导电边缘通道中的伪法拉第效应以及由尖端的近端局部场引起的这些通道中的磁散射。

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《二维拓扑绝缘体磁力成像中的反常边缘对比度》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Contrasting Γ- and K-Valley Moiré Physics in Twisted Monolayer/Bilayer WSe₂
full_list.title_zh: 对比扭转单层/双层 WSe2 中的 γ 谷莫尔物理和 K 谷莫尔物理
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2607.18212v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Electronic orbital character plays a central role in determining electronic correlations, spin-orbit coupling, dimensionality, and ultimately the quantum phases of condensed-matter systems. Two-dimensional moiré materials have emerged as highly tunable platforms for exploring correlated phenomena, but the role of orbital degrees of freedom remains largely unexplored. Here, we identify twisted monolayer/bilayer WSe₂ as a platform in which displacement-field tuning enables moiré physics to be realized in both the K and Γ valleys. The distinct orbital characters of these valleys give rise to contrasting correlated phases at moiré filling factors ν=1 and ν=1/3. At ν=1, the K-valley state is a weak insulator, consistent with an antiferromagnetic state near a van Hove singularity in the intermediate-coupling regime, similar to that observed in twisted bilayer WSe₂. In contrast, the Γ-valley state exhibits a pronounced Pomeranchuk effect, consistent with proximity to a Mott transition. At ν=1/3, the K valley hosts a robust generalized Wigner crystal, whereas the Γ-valley state lies near the crystallization boundary and again exhibits a Pomeranchuk effect, with localization enhanced by increasing temperature or magnetic field. Our work highlights the importance of orbital character in defining quantum phases in moiré systems, and identify the Γ valley as a promising platform for exploring correlated phenomena near quantum phase transitions, where competing phases and enhanced fluctuations may give rise to unconventional phases.
full_list.abstract_zh: 电子轨道特征在确定电子相关性、自旋轨道耦合、维度以及最终凝聚态物质系统的量子相方面发挥着核心作用。二维莫尔材料已成为探索相关现象的高度可调平台，但轨道自由度的作用在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们将扭曲的单层/双层 WSe2 确定为一个平台，在该平台中，位移场调谐使得莫尔物理能够在 K 谷和 Γ 谷中实现。这些谷的独特轨道特征在莫尔填充因子 ν=1 和 ν=1/3 处产生对比相关相位。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 电子轨道特征在确定电子相关性、自旋轨道耦合、维度以及最终凝聚态物质系统的量子相方面发挥着核心作用。二维莫尔材料已成为探索相关现象的高度可调平台，但轨道自由度的作用在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们将扭曲的单层/双层 WSe2 确定为一个平台，在该平台中，位移场调谐使得莫尔物理能够在 K 谷和 Γ 谷中实现。这些谷的独特轨道特征在莫尔填充因子 ν=1 和 ν=1/3 处产生对比相关相位。当 ν=1 时，K 谷态是弱绝缘体，与中间耦合状态中范霍夫奇点附近的反铁磁态一致，类似于在扭曲双层 WSe2 中观察到的情况。相比之下，γ谷态表现出明显的波美兰丘克效应，与接近莫特跃迁一致。在 ν=1/3 时，K 谷存在鲁棒的广义维格纳晶体，而 γ 谷态位于结晶边界附近，并再次表现出波美兰丘克效应，通过增加温度或磁场来增强局域化。我们的工作强调了轨道特征在定义莫尔系统中的量子相方面的重要性，并将 Γ 谷确定为探索量子相变附近相关现象的有前景的平台，其中竞争相和增强的涨落可能会产生非常规相。

full_list.title_en: Engineering superconductivity on the surface of Weyl semimetals
full_list.title_zh: 外尔半金属表面的工程超导
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2604.26859v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ten years after the experimental discovery of Weyl semimetals, theoretical and experimental work has pointed to the possibility of realizing surface-only superconductivity at relatively high temperatures in these materials. A consensus is developing that this unusual form of superconductivity is supported by surface electronic states unique to Weyl semimetals, known as Fermi arcs. In this work, we show that the topological protection of these exotic states can be exploited to engineer high critical temperatures. Motivated by reports of van Hove singularities on the surface of PtBi₂-the first Weyl semimetal in which surface superconductivity was unequivocally linked to its Fermi arcs-we demonstrate how such singularities can be engineered through the deposition of a suitable additional layer. We find that the critical temperature becomes extremely sensitive to the exact value of the chemical potential, and values as large as 20 times the bulk T_c can be achieved. More generally, our results demonstrate how topological protection can be exploited to manipulate surface electronic states, thereby opening experimentally accessible routes toward engineering high-temperature two-dimensional superconductivity and other exotic phases.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在实验发现外尔半金属十年后，理论和实验工作指出了在这些材料中在相对较高的温度下实现仅表面超导的可能性。人们正在形成共识，即这种不寻常的超导形式是由韦尔半金属特有的表面电子态（称为费米弧）支持的。在这项工作中，我们表明可以利用这些奇异态的拓扑保护来设计高临界温度。 PtBi2 是第一种表面超导性与其费米弧明确相关的外尔半金属，受 PtBi2 表面范霍夫奇点报道的启发，我们演示了如何通过沉积合适的附加层来设计此类奇点。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在实验发现外尔半金属十年后，理论和实验工作指出了在这些材料中在相对较高的温度下实现仅表面超导的可能性。人们正在形成共识，即这种不寻常的超导形式是由韦尔半金属特有的表面电子态（称为费米弧）支持的。在这项工作中，我们表明可以利用这些奇异态的拓扑保护来设计高临界温度。 PtBi2 是第一种表面超导性与其费米弧明确相关的外尔半金属，受 PtBi2 表面范霍夫奇点报道的启发，我们演示了如何通过沉积合适的附加层来设计此类奇点。我们发现临界温度对化学势的精确值变得极其敏感，并且可以达到高达本体 T_c 20 倍的值。更一般地说，我们的结果证明了如何利用拓扑保护来操纵表面电子态，从而为工程高温二维超导和其他奇异相开辟了实验可行的途径。
full_list.summary: 在实验发现外尔半金属十年后，理论和实验工作指出了在这些材料中在相对较高的温度下实现仅表面超导的可能性。人们正在形成共识，即这种不寻常的超导形式是由韦尔半金属特有的表面电子态（称为费米弧）支持的。在这项工作中，我们表明可以利用这些奇异态的拓扑保护来设计高临界温度。 PtBi2 是第一种表面超导性与其费米弧明确相关的外尔半金属，受 PtBi2 表面范霍夫奇点报道的启发，我们演示了如何通过沉积合适的附加层来设计此类奇点。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《外尔半金属表面的工程超导》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

research_direction_note: 本日文献与团队研究的交集主要集中在密度泛函理论和电子结构计算、热力学自由能、相稳定与有限温度建模、等变神经网络与对称性保持表示、分子动力学与有限温度轨迹，并落到铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程、磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合、晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系、缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学。对现有工作最直接的价值是提供可复用的表示、采样或验证流程，而不是替代具体材料体系的物理判断。后续筛选应优先核对原文数据是否包含结构、能量、力、应力、极化、自旋或有限温度轨迹，再决定是否迁移到铁电、磁性、缺陷和外场驱动模拟。

core_items.title_en: Electric-Field Driven Nuclear Dynamics of Liquids and Solids from a Multi-Valued Machine-Learned Dipolar Model
core_items.title_zh: 来自多值机器学习偶极模型的电场驱动液体和固体核动力学
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2502.02413v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The driving of vibrational motion by external electric fields is a topic of continued interest, due to the possibility of assessing new or metastable material phases with desirable properties. Here, we combine ab initio molecular dynamics within the electric-dipole approximation with machine-learning neural networks (NNs) to develop a general, efficient and accurate method to perform electric-field-driven nuclear dynamics for molecules, solids, and liquids. We train equivariant and autodifferentiable NNs for the interatomic potential and the dipole, modifying the model infrastructure to account for the multi-valued nature of the latter in periodic systems. We showcase the method by addressing property modifications induced by electric field interactions in a polar liquid and a polar solid from nanosecond-long molecular dynamics simulations with quantum-mechanical accuracy. For liquid water, we present a calculation of the dielectric function in the GHz to THz range and the electrofreezing transition, showing that nuclear quantum effects enhance this phenomenon. For the ferroelectric perovskite LiNbO₃, we simulate the ferroelectric to paraelectric phase transition and the non-equilibrium dynamics of driven phonon modes related to the polarization switching mechanisms, showing that a full polarization switch is not achieved in the simulations.
core_items.abstract_zh: 由于可以评估具有所需特性的新的或亚稳态的材料相，因此外部电场驱动振动运动是人们持续关注的话题。在这里，我们将电偶极近似中的从头算分子动力学与机器学习神经网络 (NN) 相结合，开发出一种通用、高效且准确的方法来对分子、固体和液体执行电场驱动的核动力学。我们针对原子间势和偶极子训练等变和自微神经网络，修改模型基础设施以考虑后者在周期系统中的多值性质。我们通过具有量子力学精度的纳秒长分子动力学模拟来解决极性液体和极性固体中电场相互作用引起的性质变化，从而展示了该方法。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 由于可以评估具有所需特性的新的或亚稳态的材料相，因此外部电场驱动振动运动是人们持续关注的话题。在这里，我们将电偶极近似中的从头算分子动力学与机器学习神经网络 (NN) 相结合，开发出一种通用、高效且准确的方法来对分子、固体和液体执行电场驱动的核动力学。我们针对原子间势和偶极子训练等变和自微神经网络，修改模型基础设施以考虑后者在周期系统中的多值性质。我们通过具有量子力学精度的纳秒长分子动力学模拟来解决极性液体和极性固体中电场相互作用引起的性质变化，从而展示了该方法。对于液态水，我们对 GHz 至 THz 范围内的介电函数和电冻结转变进行了计算，表明核量子效应增强了这种现象。对于铁电钙钛矿LiNbO₃，我们模拟了铁电到顺电的相变以及与偏振切换机制相关的驱动声子模式的非平衡动力学，表明在模拟中没有实现完全的偏振切换。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：等变神经网络与对称性保持表示, 分子动力学与有限温度轨迹，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《来自多值机器学习偶极模型的电场驱动液体和固体核动力学》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Alter-excitons in Altermagnets: Symmetry, Splitting and Dispersion
core_items.title_zh: 交变磁体中的交变激子：对称性、分裂和色散
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.12900v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Magnetism provides a fertile platform for discovering emergent quantum phenomena governed by symmetry. Recent developments of spin-space-group (SSG) theory have revealed altermagnets as a distinct class of nonrelativistic collinear magnets with unconventional spin-dependent electronic structures. Here, we demonstrate that altermagnetic symmetry imposes fundamentally different constraints on electronic and excitonic excitations. Although the quasiparticle and two-body Hamiltonians possess identical SSG symmetries, we find that symmetry-protected degeneracies present in the electronic band structure can be intrinsically lifted in the exciton spectrum at specific momenta. This splitting arises solely from the many-body nature of excitons and does not require spin-orbit coupling or noncollinear magnetic order. Combining symmetry analysis with many-body perturbation theory, we predict a novel class of spin-split excitonic quasiparticles, termed alter-excitons, and reveal their characteristic dispersions in altermagnetic systems. Our results establish excitons as a sensitive probe of hidden spin-space symmetries and uncover a new route toward symmetry-engineered many-body phenomena in collinear magnets.
core_items.abstract_zh: 磁性为发现受对称性支配的新兴量子现象提供了丰富的平台。自旋空间群（SSG）理论的最新发展揭示了交替磁体是一类独特的非相对论共线磁体，具有非常规的自旋相关电子结构。在这里，我们证明交变磁对称性对电子和激子激发施加了根本不同的约束。尽管准粒子和二体哈密顿量具有相同的 SSG 对称性，但我们发现电子能带结构中存在的对称保护简并性可以在特定动量的激子谱中本质上被提升。这种分裂仅由激子的多体性质引起，不需要自旋轨道耦合或非共线磁序。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 磁性为发现受对称性支配的新兴量子现象提供了丰富的平台。自旋空间群（SSG）理论的最新发展揭示了交替磁体是一类独特的非相对论共线磁体，具有非常规的自旋相关电子结构。在这里，我们证明交变磁对称性对电子和激子激发施加了根本不同的约束。尽管准粒子和二体哈密顿量具有相同的 SSG 对称性，但我们发现电子能带结构中存在的对称保护简并性可以在特定动量的激子谱中本质上被提升。这种分裂仅由激子的多体性质引起，不需要自旋轨道耦合或非共线磁序。将对称分析与多体微扰理论相结合，我们预测了一类新型的自旋分裂激子准粒子，称为交变激子，并揭示了它们在交变磁系统中的特征色散。我们的研究结果将激子确立为隐藏自旋空间对称性的敏感探针，并揭示了共线磁体中对称工程多体现象的新途径。

core_items.title_en: Homogeneous to multi-scale inhomogeneous complex magnetism in Ba3LnRu2O9 (Ln = Gd, Ho), Revealed by muSR and Machine-Learned Muon-Site Calculations
core_items.title_zh: 通过muSR和机器学习Muon-Site计算揭示的Ba3LnRu2O9 （ Ln = Gd ， Ho ）中的均匀至多尺度不均匀复合磁性
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.12726v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a comprehensive muon spin rotation and relaxation (muSR) study of the hexagonal 6H-perovskites Ba3LnRu2O9 (Ln = Gd, Ho) to investigate the role of rare-earth anisotropy in the magnetic ground state of 4d-4f coupled systems. Ba3HoRu2O9 exhibits two successive magnetic orderings at TN1 = 46 K and TN2 = 10 K, leading to a complex magnetic ground state, whereas Ba3GdRu2O9, with Gd3+ (L = 0) S-state ions, shows primarily single magnetic ordering at TN = 14.5 K. Zero-field (ZF) and longitudinal-field (LF) muSR measurements reveal markedly different magnetic behavior despite their structural similarity. Ba3HoRu2O9 displays a multi-scale inhomogeneous magnetic state characterized by two-component exponential relaxation, broad local-field distributions, incomplete LF decoupling, and persistent spin dynamics. The muSR results identify two characteristic magnetic energy scales near 46 and 10 K, associated with correlated Ru-Ho interactions and quasistatic magnetic ordering, respectively. Redfield analysis further demonstrates strong local magnetic fields and distributed spin fluctuation timescales, confirming magnetic inhomogeneity. Machine-learning-assisted muon-site and dipolar-field calculations show that the broad field distribution naturally arises from muons sensing distinct coexisting magnetic domains at different structural sites. In contrast, Ba3GdRu2O9 exhibits a comparatively homogeneous antiferromagnetic ground state below 14.5 K, with Gaussian relaxation consistent with a narrow static field distribution. These results establish that the rare-earth ion in Ba3LnRu2O9 is a powerful tuning parameter, driving the ground state from homogeneous to complex, multi-scale inhomogeneous behavior through competing 4d-4f magnetic interactions.
core_items.abstract_zh: 我们报告了六方6H-钙钛矿Ba3LnRu2O9 （ Ln = Gd ， Ho ）的综合介子自旋旋转和弛豫（ muSR ）研究，以研究稀土各向异性在4d-4f耦合系统磁基态中的作用。Ba3HoRu2O9在TN1 = 46 K和TN2 = 10 K时表现出两个连续的磁有序，导致复杂的磁基态，而Ba3GdRu2O9在Gd3 + (L = 0) S态离子下，在TN = 14.5 K时主要表现出单一的磁有序。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了六方6H-钙钛矿Ba3LnRu2O9 （ Ln = Gd ， Ho ）的综合介子自旋旋转和弛豫（ muSR ）研究，以研究稀土各向异性在4d-4f耦合系统磁基态中的作用。Ba3HoRu2O9在TN1 = 46 K和TN2 = 10 K时表现出两个连续的磁有序，导致复杂的磁基态，而Ba3GdRu2O9在Gd3 + (L = 0) S态离子下，在TN = 14.5 K时主要表现出单一的磁有序。零场（ ZF ）和纵场（ LF ） muSR测量显示，尽管它们的结构相似，但磁性行为却明显不同。Ba3HoRu2O9呈现多尺度不均匀磁态，其特征为双分量指数弛豫、广域分布、不完全LF解耦和持续自旋动力学。MuSR结果确定了46和10 K附近的两个特征磁能量尺度，分别与相关的Ru-Ho相互作用和准静态磁有序性相关。雷德菲尔德分析进一步证明了强大的局部磁场和分布式自旋波动时间尺度，证实了磁不均匀性。机器学习辅助μ子位点和偶极场计算表明，宽场分布自然源于μ子在不同结构位点感应到不同的共存磁畴。相比之下， Ba3GdRu2O9在14.5 K以下表现出相对均匀的反铁磁基态，高斯弛豫与狭窄的静态场分布一致。这些结果表明， Ba3LnRu2O9中的稀土离子是一个强大的调谐参数，通过竞争性的4d-4f磁相互作用，将基态从均匀驱动到复杂、多尺度的不均匀行为。

core_items.title_en: Improved screening of doped ZrO₂ catalysts for CO₂ hydrogenation from graph-based machine learning
core_items.title_zh: 通过基于图形的机器学习改进用于 CO2 加氢的掺杂 ZrO2 催化剂的筛选
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.13795v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dopants can tune the activity of zirconia-based CO₂ hydrogenation catalysts through changes in adsorbate and transition-state (TS) energetics. Computing these quantities with density functional theory (DFT) becomes expensive when several dopants, reaction intermediates, and TSs must be screened. Here, we further develop the graph-based machine learning method Wasserstein Weisfeiler-Lehman Gaussian Process Regression (WWL-GPR): we introduce additional electronic-structure and local-environment features relevant for oxide surfaces and use the resulting model to predict adsorption and TS energies on ZrO₂(101) surfaces doped with Al³⁺, Cd²⁺, Ga³⁺, In³⁺, and Zn²⁺. Adsorbate-surface structures are represented as attributed graphs that combine bonds connectivity and features. We benchmark WWL-GPR against thermodynamic scaling relations (TSR) for reaction intermediates and Bronsted-Evans-Polanyi relations (BEP) for TSs, and then propagate the predicted energies to microkinetic CH₃OH-yield estimates. WWL-GPR consistently improves the prediction of reaction intermediate energetics relative to linear scaling approaches and provides TS estimates that are competitive with BEP-based models. These improvements become especially relevant when the predicted energetics are propagated through the reaction network. Microkinetic calculations show that WWL-GPR-derived energies give CH₃OH yields closer to DFT-derived yields than the linear-relation workflow. Degree-of-rate-control analysis links the activity errors to dopant-dependent rate-controlling steps, including HCOO* formation, H₂COOH* dissociation, and H₃CO* formation. These results support WWL-GPR as a data-efficient surrogate for connecting atomistic energetics with catalyst-screening observables on doped oxide surfaces.
core_items.abstract_zh: 掺杂剂可以通过吸附质和过渡态 (TS) 能量的变化来调节氧化锆基 CO2 加氢催化剂的活性。当必须筛选多种掺杂剂、反应中间体和 TS 时，使用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算这些量变得昂贵。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 掺杂剂可以通过吸附质和过渡态 (TS) 能量的变化来调节氧化锆基 CO2 加氢催化剂的活性。当必须筛选多种掺杂剂、反应中间体和 TS 时，使用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算这些量变得昂贵。在这里，我们进一步开发了基于图的机器学习方法 Wasserstein Weisfeiler-Lehman 高斯过程回归 (WWL-GPR)：我们引入了与氧化物表面相关的附加电子结构和局部环境特征，并使用所得模型来预测掺杂 Al3⁺、Cd2⁺、Ga3⁺、In3⁺ 和 Zn2⁺ 的 ZrO2(101) 表面上的吸附和 TS 能量。吸附物表面结构表示为结合了键连接性和特征的属性图。我们将 WWL-GPR 与反应中间体的热力学标度关系 (TSR) 和 TS 的布朗斯台德-埃文斯-波兰尼关系 (BEP) 进行基准测试，然后将预测的能量传播到微动力学 CH₃OH 产率估计。相对于线性标度方法，WWL-GPR 持续改进了反应中间体能量学的预测，并提供了与基于 BEP 的模型相媲美的 TS 估计。当预测的能量通过反应网络传播时，这些改进变得尤其重要。微动力学计算表明，与线性关系工作流程相比，WWL-GPR 衍生的能量使 CH₃OH 产率更接近 DFT 衍生的产率。速率控制程度分析将活度误差与掺杂剂相关的速率控制步骤联系起来，包括 HCOO* 形成、H2COOH* 解离和 H₃CO* 形成。这些结果支持 WWL-GPR 作为一种数据高效的替代品，用于将原子能量学与掺杂氧化物表面上的催化剂筛选可观测值联系起来。
core_items.summary: 掺杂剂可以通过吸附质和过渡态 (TS) 能量的变化来调节氧化锆基 CO2 加氢催化剂的活性。当必须筛选多种掺杂剂、反应中间体和 TS 时，使用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算这些量变得昂贵。
core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：密度泛函理论和电子结构计算, 热力学自由能、相稳定与有限温度建模，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《通过基于图形的机器学习改进用于 CO2 加氢的掺杂 ZrO2 催化剂的筛选》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Electron-Density-Informed Molecular Property Prediction Using Surrogate Functionals
core_items.title_zh: 使用替代泛函进行基于电子密度的分子性质预测
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.13649v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning methods are increasingly used to predict chemical properties directly from the molecular structure to bypass the often prohibitive cost of quantum mechanical calculations. Recent work has shown that including the ground-state electron density as input to the machine learning model can improve accuracy in this setting. This work employs the recent surrogate functional framework originally developed for orbital-free density functional theory and extends it to predicting molecular properties. We show that passing the ground-state density as input to the model, while simultaneously enforcing it to be the minimum of the surrogate functional, surpasses state-of-the-art performance for six out of seven extensive properties of the QM9 dataset. Additionally, the approach shows improved generalization to larger molecules taken from the QM40 dataset. On all extensive properties of both datasets, our approach outperforms models that are informed by the ground-state density but do not enforce the surrogate functional constraints.
core_items.abstract_zh: 机器学习方法越来越多地用于直接从分子结构预测化学性质，以绕过量子力学计算通常高昂的成本。最近的工作表明，将基态电子密度作为机器学习模型的输入可以提高这种设置的准确性。这项工作采用了最初为无轨道密度泛函理论开发的最新替代泛函框架，并将其扩展到预测分子特性。我们表明，将基态密度作为模型的输入传递，同时强制其为代理函数的最小值，在 QM9 数据集的七个广泛属性中的六个方面都超过了最先进的性能。此外，该方法还显示出对 QM40 数据集中较大分子的泛化能力有所提高。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习方法越来越多地用于直接从分子结构预测化学性质，以绕过量子力学计算通常高昂的成本。最近的工作表明，将基态电子密度作为机器学习模型的输入可以提高这种设置的准确性。这项工作采用了最初为无轨道密度泛函理论开发的最新替代泛函框架，并将其扩展到预测分子特性。我们表明，将基态密度作为模型的输入传递，同时强制其为代理函数的最小值，在 QM9 数据集的七个广泛属性中的六个方面都超过了最先进的性能。此外，该方法还显示出对 QM40 数据集中较大分子的泛化能力有所提高。在两个数据集的所有广泛属性上，我们的方法优于由基态密度告知但不强制替代功能约束的模型。
core_items.summary: 机器学习方法越来越多地用于直接从分子结构预测化学性质，以绕过量子力学计算通常高昂的成本。最近的工作表明，将基态电子密度作为机器学习模型的输入可以提高这种设置的准确性。这项工作采用了最初为无轨道密度泛函理论开发的最新替代泛函框架，并将其扩展到预测分子特性。我们表明，将基态密度作为模型的输入传递，同时强制其为代理函数的最小值，在 QM9 数据集的七个广泛属性中的六个方面都超过了最先进的性能。此外，该方法还显示出对 QM40 数据集中较大分子的泛化能力有所提高。
core_items.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：密度泛函理论和电子结构计算。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对《使用替代泛函进行基于电子密度的分子性质预测》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: A Generalizable Machine Learning Framework for Half-Heusler Thermoelectrics
core_items.title_zh: Half-Heusler 热电的通用机器学习框架
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2602.01149v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine learning (ML) has emerged as a powerful approach for accelerating the discovery of thermoelectric (TE) materials, yet many models suffer from limited generalizability. Here we present a robust ML framework for predicting the thermoelectric figure of merit (zT) in half-Heusler (hH) compounds, emphasizing prediction of previously unseen compositions. A principal component analysis (PCA)-based train/test splitting strategy is introduced to generate representative partitions of chemical space. Bayesian hyperparameter optimization is combined with correlation-based k-best feature selection for Random Forest, XGBoost, and Neural Network models, together with the interpretable SISSO symbolic-regression method. Relative to the full set of 118 input features, the optimized feature subsets reduce the test RMSE by 16-27%. SHAP and SISSO analyses identify temperature, A-site dopant concentration, and A-site heat of vaporization as the most important descriptors of zT. The framework is validated through prediction of previously unexplored compositions, recovery of literature-reported optimal zT values for established hH systems, and first-principles calculations for the new compounds CeCoBi and CeIrBi, which exhibit favorable electronic transport properties. The framework is further applied to high-throughput screening of the doped hH chemical space, covering about 2.46 million elemental substitution combinations across 631 thermodynamically screened parent matrices under stability constraints. This screening yields a concise set of promising candidates for future study. Overall, the work establishes a generalizable workflow for reliable data-driven thermoelectric materials discovery.
core_items.abstract_zh: 机器学习 (ML) 已成为加速热电 (TE) 材料发现的强大方法，但许多模型的通用性有限。在这里，我们提出了一个强大的机器学习框架，用于预测 half-Heusler (hH) 化合物的热电品质因数 (zT)，强调预测以前未见过的成分。引入基于主成分分析（PCA）的训练/测试分割策略来生成化学空间的代表性分区。贝叶斯超参数优化与随机森林、XGBoost 和神经网络模型的基于相关性的 k 最佳特征选择以及可解释的 SISSO 符号回归方法相结合。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习 (ML) 已成为加速热电 (TE) 材料发现的强大方法，但许多模型的通用性有限。在这里，我们提出了一个强大的机器学习框架，用于预测 half-Heusler (hH) 化合物的热电品质因数 (zT)，强调预测以前未见过的成分。引入基于主成分分析（PCA）的训练/测试分割策略来生成化学空间的代表性分区。贝叶斯超参数优化与随机森林、XGBoost 和神经网络模型的基于相关性的 k 最佳特征选择以及可解释的 SISSO 符号回归方法相结合。相对于全套 118 个输入特征，优化后的特征子集将测试 RMSE 降低了 16-27%。 SHAP 和 SISSO 分析将温度、A 位掺杂剂浓度和 A 位汽化热确定为 zT 最重要的描述符。该框架通过预测先前未探索的成分、恢复文献报道的已建立 hH 系统的最佳 zT 值以及新化合物 CeCoBi 和 CeIrBi 的第一原理计算来验证，这些化合物表现出良好的电子传输特性。该框架进一步应用于掺杂 hH 化学空间的高通量筛选，覆盖了稳定性约束下的 631 个热力学筛选母体中约 246 万个元素取代组合。这种筛选产生了一组简明的有前途的候选者供未来研究。总体而言，这项工作为可靠的数据驱动热电材料发现建立了一个通用的工作流程。

core_items.title_en: Analog quantum simulation of Shastry-Sutherland Ising materials
core_items.title_zh: Shastry-Sutherland Ising 材料的模拟量子模拟
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.12800v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Frustrated magnets host rich emergent behavior because competing interactions generate dense manifolds of low-energy states. The Ising Shastry-Sutherland model is a paradigmatic setting, motivated experimentally by Ising-like rare-earth tetraborides such as TmB₄ and ErB₄, whose field-induced magnetization plateaus have motivated extensive microscopic modeling. Yet how tunable quantum fluctuations reorganize this material-motivated phase diagram remains largely unexplored. Here, we realize a transverse- and longitudinal-field Ising model on the Shastry-Sutherland lattice using a programmable Rydberg-atom array. We map its quantum phase diagram using density matrix renormalization group calculations and probe corresponding signatures experimentally in arrays containing more than 110 atoms. Beyond the established classical phases, the calculations identify two regimes absent in the classical limit and stabilized at finite transverse field: a 2/5 filling plateau whose finite stability region emerges from a classically degenerate phase boundary and a symmetry-preserving quantum-dimer regime replacing classically selected collinear order. Experiments on finite open arrays reveal signatures consistent with these regimes across three boundary-pinning conditions, with the resulting response maps agreeing qualitatively with the calculated phase diagram. Our results establish programmable Rydberg-atom arrays as tools for exploring frustrated, material-motivated Hamiltonians and motivate searches for new, quantum-driven magnetization plateaus and quantum-dimer behavior in ErB₄ under a transverse field or in strain-tuned TmB₄.
core_items.abstract_zh: 受挫的磁体具有丰富的涌现行为，因为竞争相互作用会产生密集的低能态流形。 Ising Shastry-Sutherland 模型是一个范例设置，由 TmB₄ 和 ErB₄ 等类似 Ising 的稀土四硼化物实验激发，其场致磁化平台激发了广泛的微观建模。然而，可调谐量子涨落如何重组这种材料驱动的相图在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们使用可编程里德堡原子阵列在 Shastry-Sutherland 晶格上实现了横向和纵向场伊辛模型。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 受挫的磁体具有丰富的涌现行为，因为竞争相互作用会产生密集的低能态流形。 Ising Shastry-Sutherland 模型是一个范例设置，由 TmB₄ 和 ErB₄ 等类似 Ising 的稀土四硼化物实验激发，其场致磁化平台激发了广泛的微观建模。然而，可调谐量子涨落如何重组这种材料驱动的相图在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们使用可编程里德堡原子阵列在 Shastry-Sutherland 晶格上实现了横向和纵向场伊辛模型。我们使用密度矩阵重正化群计算绘制其量子相图，并在包含超过 110 个原子的阵列中通过实验探测相应的特征。除了已建立的经典相之外，计算还确定了经典极限中不存在且在有限横向场下稳定的两种状态：2/5 填充平台，其有限稳定区域从经典简并相边界中出现，以及对称性保持的量子二聚体状态取代了经典选择的共线顺序。有限开放阵列的实验揭示了在三个边界钉扎条件下与这些状态一致的特征，所得的响应图与计算的相图定性地一致。我们的结果建立了可编程里德堡原子阵列作为探索受挫的、材料驱动的哈密顿量的工具，并激发了对横向场或应变调谐 TmB₄ 下 ErB₄ 中新的量子驱动磁化平台和量子二聚体行为的搜索。
